user_approval: 采用模长的截尾总体标准差（推荐，与既有 r674 方针一致）
scope: All vector heads in the existing delivered v3.1 schema; original target identities, masks and exposure policies remain authoritative.

normalization.scale_definition: Population standard deviation of the existing invariant vector-norm series after the already frozen exact type7 0.001/0.999 statistical-copy winsorization.
normalization.norm_series_selection: Existing physical_key mapping: atom_vector uses <field_id>/norm; other vector heads use physical/<registry_id>/<task>/norm.

datasets.P_D: Use only its own actual final Common TRAIN minus actual D5 producer statistics.
datasets.Pprime: Use only its own actual final Common TRAIN first2 minus actual D5 independent producer statistics; no PM7 substitution.

r674: Existing formal D1 policy and LOSS_DISABLED/UNKNOWN exposure flags remain unchanged.
degenerate_scale: Preserve the existing target-local disabled/unbound behavior for empty, undefined or zero scale; no invented epsilon.
implementation_scope: Metadata binding to already running statistics only; no added scan, refit, clipping of source labels or change to scientific population.
